analyst.summary: LT Foods (Daawat, Royal) is the world's largest branded basmati rice company and just posted strong Q1 FY27 results — revenue up roughly 27% YoY with genuine international market-share gains — while continuing to deleverage its balance sheet. The stock's 12-month price decline looks disconnected from these improving fundamentals, likely reflecting periodic rice-export-policy sentiment risk rather than a real business problem. At ~21x earnings we rate it a Hold.
